design.selection: Outcome-blind carry-forward of four repository-disjoint untouched development cases

A-strong-agent-control.measurement_note: The gpflow value is the sum of preserved active generation, hidden qualification, and Official continuation components after a user interruption; it is not a single uninterrupted wrapper measurement.

wall_time_seconds.causal_interpretation: Descriptive only. Four stochastic trajectories per arm, schedule order, package-cache state, network conditions, and deployment-path choices confound efficiency comparisons.

model_input_tokens.policy: Reported as a secondary measurement, never used as a hard stopping threshold.

findings.primary_effect: No Official Pass@1 gain was observed for one-shot or retryable clean replay. All arms solved all four cases, so this small gate is success-saturated and cannot estimate performance on harder failures.
findings.mechanism: The same-session retryable loop is implemented correctly and can revise a submitted program after fresh-environment feedback.
findings.mechanism_validity_limit: Both activated repairs were caused by the frozen provenance boundary, not by Official EnvBench missing-import failures. They establish mechanism execution, not benchmark-success benefit.
findings.benchmark_validity_gap: On neuralforecast, an intentionally incomplete no-deps environment passed Official EnvBench because the measured imports were present. Official success and complete runnable deployment are distinct outcomes.
findings.path_quality_variance: Independent strong-Agent trajectories reached metric-minimal, complete CPU-only, and complete default-CUDA solutions. Package and hardware choices dominated time, storage, and network use before replay feedback could matter.
findings.occam_reading: The current evidence does not justify adding more cross-candidate constraints or promoting retryable certification as the core success algorithm.

decision.reason: The gate validates implementation but shows no primary-metric gain; its two repairs target self-imposed admissibility defects, while trajectory evidence points to deployment-path quality and hard Official failures as the unresolved scientific targets.

next_experiment_constraints.selection: Preregister an untouched outcome-blind random or stratified sample; never select cases from observed outcomes.
next_experiment_constraints.success_axis: Measure recovery on actual Official failures with enough discordant pairs to estimate effect.
next_experiment_constraints.quality_axis: Evaluate deployment completeness and resource path quality separately from Official Pass@1.
next_experiment_constraints.algorithm_policy: Do not add a new structured rule unless repeated trajectories identify the same causal failure mode and a simpler intervention cannot address it.
next_experiment_constraints.execution: Not started; requires discussion and preregistration.
